title: Disinvestment Target Set at ₹80,000 Crore for FY27
summary: Centre set disinvestment and asset monetization target of Rs 80,000 crore for FY27 (135% higher than RE FY26 of Rs 33,837 Cr), banking on IDBI Bank and LIC.
